sentences.en: Was it necessary to inflict such a punishment on him?
sentences.zh: 对他施加这样的惩罚有必要吗？

sentences.en: Anyone who breaks this rule is liable to severe punishment.
sentences.zh: 任何违反这条规则的人都有可能受到严厉的惩罚。

sentences.en: Shizuko cheated in an examination and received an appropriate punishment.
sentences.zh: 志织在考试中作弊并因此受到了适当的惩罚。

senses.zh: 刑罚，惩罚,严厉对待,<口>给吃苦头
